# PlayerBreakingBlockEventOptions Interface

> [!CAUTION]
> This interface is still in pre-release.  Its signature may change or it may be removed in future releases.

An interface that is passed into [*@minecraft/server.PlayerStartBreakingBlockAfterEventSignal.subscribe*](../../../scriptapi/minecraft/server/PlayerStartBreakingBlockAfterEventSignal.md#subscribe) or [*@minecraft/server.PlayerCancelBreakingBlockAfterEventSignal.subscribe*](../../../scriptapi/minecraft/server/PlayerCancelBreakingBlockAfterEventSignal.md#subscribe) that filters out which events are passed to the provided callback.

## Properties

### **blockFilter**
`blockFilter?: BlockFilter;`

The [*@minecraft/server.BlockFilter*](../../../scriptapi/minecraft/server/BlockFilter.md) that the callback should be called for. If undefined, the callback will be called for all blocks.

Type: [*BlockFilter*](BlockFilter.md)

### **playerFilter**
`playerFilter?: EntityFilter;`

The [*@minecraft/server.EntityFilter*](../../../scriptapi/minecraft/server/EntityFilter.md) that the callback should be called for. If undefined, the callback will be called for all players.

Type: [*EntityFilter*](EntityFilter.md)
